summary: Detailed documentation of UCSB's Remote Job Service, following up on RFC 436. It restates the essence of the official RJE protocol in RFC 407 and describes the subset UCSB implemented, listing what was not supported. A rewrite was planned for about six months later.

eli5.summary: A manual for a university computer that took jobs sent over the network, including a list of the things it could not yet do.
